# Well Done Streams

Public pages for the Well Done Streams media-request service:

- https://welldonestreams.com/ — access, setup, and request instructions
- https://welldonestreams.com/casino.html — WellDoneBets points games
- https://welldonestreams.com/privacy.html — privacy policy
- https://welldonestreams.com/terms.html — terms of use

Private account, admin, and API data are not documented here.
